title: Look at my level system
author: RottTheDev
selftext: Any suggestions of my mobile game level map system or development of UI. Doing with ai. I know it's early but I'm open to any kind of suggestions.(Mute for fan voice:))

comments.author: ChocoMaxXx
comments.body: Maybe put the level who are far ( top) and bot a little bit smaller

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: This is EXACTLY like the tower in one of my favourite games from my childhood, Super Ghouls'n' Ghosts.

replies.author: RottTheDev
replies.body: Really? I never seen this game. I searched but couldn't find the levels can you send me

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body: The end of the third stage, where you fight a floating dragon-worm creature boss. Look on YouTube: SNES "Super Ghouls'n Ghosts".

replies.author: RottTheDev
replies.body: I saw it. İt really looks similar. Thanks for informing me

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body: Don't take it as something bad, the opposite. It's just pure nostalgia to me.

replies.author: RottTheDev
replies.body: I'm happy to give you that feelings.
